intelligenceRequirement: Discover and disposition the finite Canadian organization universe behind twelve observed GSC capability queries across hyperspectral imagery, secure software-defined networks, Ka-band RF conversion, smallsat RF mission services, persistent maritime surveillance and defence investment casting, then prepare only novel evidence-cleared companies for private review.

priorityQuestions.question: Which exact operating and legal identity, ownership boundary and Canadian delivery footprint can durable sources support for each novel prospect?
Which named product, service or manufacturing process is independently reviewable, and which functions, interfaces or process limits are publicly supported?
What customer, contract, grant, program, partner, certification, deployment or transaction evidence bounds current maturity without implying defence adoption?
Which unresolved identity, lifecycle, ownership, workshare, accreditation, delivery or customer boundary could change the reviewer decision and what exact follow-up action is justified?

site:squarepeg.ca RF base station OEM subsystem Kanata
expectedClaims: Record-specific identity, offering, proof, access or material-unknown evidence recovered through the official site lane.

stopConditions: Stop only after all 54 finite cluster-prospect rows have one truthful selected, research-required, duplicate-existing or exclusion disposition.
Stop collection when each cluster's final two complementary lanes yield only already represented, foreign, entity-kind-conflicted, process-mismatched or materially unresolved identities.
Do not stage any organization with an unresolved duplicate, Canadian nexus, ownership, lifecycle, concrete-offering or durable-evidence boundary.
